text:
Lee (Support): NimbusHealth (dedicated) reporting major latency + throughput regression after yesterday's model rollout. p95 went from ~220ms -> ~1.8s; sustained throughput down ~45%. Customer SLA flagged. Ticket SUP-892. Attaching quick request logs and sample trace ids.

Oncall Bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-NIMBUS-LATENCY by Lee (Support)

Lee (Support): logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:14:22Z request_id=5f1d... status=200 latency_ms=1800 model=redwood-open-7b-quant-v2 route=prod-default
2026-03-15T03:14:23Z request_id=5f1d... status=200 latency_ms=1750 model=redwood-open-7b-quant-v2 route=prod-default
```

Alex K: @Samir R @Aditya (Infra) can you pull the deploy that rolled the quantized kernels? Which kernel/profile is being used for this customer's dedicated pool?

Samir R: Looking. Early signal in canary showed slight p50 bump but not like this. Will check kernel selection + batch sizing. @Alex K do we have per-pool kernel overrides? :thinking:

Aditya (Infra): We added a kernel fallback for int8 in the last rollout — might be picking a slower generic GEMM path for that sequence length. Pinning to previous kernel helped in a local repro. Need permission to roll customer pool back to redwood-open-7b-quant-v1.

Maria G: Customer is enterprise Dedicated contract. This is P1 from product POV. Jess (Product) are we ok to prioritize immediate rollback vs mitigation? Need timeline to restore SLA.

Jess (Product): Prioritize rollback to v1 for NimbusHealth now if infra confirms rollback reduces p95 < 300ms and throughput ~>90% baseline. Acceptance criteria: p95 < 300ms, throughput >= 90% of last week's baseline for 30m continuous. Also require postmortem and a canary gating improvement before re-rollout.

Alex K: Agreed. @Aditya (Infra) please submit a change with rollback and expected ETA. If rollback not possible quickly, we can route their traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-open-7b-legacy) as interim.

Aditya (Infra): Rolling back now to quant-v1 on their pool, ETA ~12m. Will post logs.

Oncall Bot: Change submitted by Aditya (Infra): rollback quant-v2 -> quant-v1 for pool nimbus-dedicated. ChangeID CHG-94732

Lee (Support): Noted, I'll update NimbusHealth and include ETA. Customer wants hourly progress. I'll open a restricted incident channel and add them to watch.

Samir R: After rollback completes, let's gather perf profiles (seq len distribution, batch sizes) and run kernel perf matrix. Also check KV cache hit rate — if cache misses increased that'll explain throughput drop.

Jess (Product): After we stabilize, add rollout requirement: automatic verification job that measures p95 and throughput against baseline on representative traffic for 1h before global rollout.

Lee (Support): Thanks team. Updating ticket SUP-892 and customer. Will post post-rollback numbers.

Aditya (Infra): Rollback completed. Preliminary p95 back to ~240ms, throughput ~93% baseline. Will monitor for 30m and then confirm.

Lee (Support): Confirmed with customer: p95 235ms, throughput 95% baseline. Closing urgent alert, keeping incident channel open for postmortem.

Jess (Product): Assigning postmortem owner: Alex K. Add timeline, root cause (kernel selection for int8), and action items (canary gating + rollback playbook). ETA for postmortem draft: 3 business days.

Alex K: Will take it. Creating PM doc and linking tests. Thanks.
